how: Claude agent reading of the stored title + abstract, blind to the curated graph, with EXTRACT_INSTRUCTIONS and CLAIM_SCHEMA

claims.quote: Pompe disease is a muscular lysosomal storage disorder characterized by autosomal recessive inheritance and caused by deficiency of the acid alpha-glucosidase (GAA) enzyme.
Among the 47 patients who received enzyme replacement therapy (ERT), the mortality rate was 6.4%, compared to 57.1% in the 21 patients who did not receive ERT.
The severity of muscle pathology correlated with lower body mass index (BMI), shorter 6-min walk test (6MWT) and spinal curvature abnormalities.
